name: Rent and ownership cost comparison
audience: Renters who have a written bond quote and want a one-year cost comparison.
summary: Compare one year of rent with one year of ownership costs you type in.
description: The sheet does not guess a bond. You enter the repayment a lender actually quoted, plus levies, rates, insurance, and maintenance. It then compares that year with rent and rent increases.
benefits: Use a quoted repayment instead of an invented bond
See the gap for one year, not a lifetime prediction
compatibility: Microsoft Excel for Microsoft 365 or Excel 2021 and later
Formulas also open in Google Sheets; confirm PMT, FV, and NPER after import
PDF guide opens in any PDF reader
DOCX guide opens in Microsoft Word or Google Docs
disclaimer: This workbook organises figures you type in. It is not financial, credit, insurance, or tax advice. Rates, fees, and laws change. A qualified adviser should review decisions that affect debt, tax, medical cover, or retirement.
